              授業科目の学習・教育目標

              キーワード
              学習・教育目標

              1.Architecture
2.Architectural Planning and Design
3.Architectural Structure
4.Architectural Environment
5.Expertise Field and Regional Cooperation

              The purpose of this course is to understand the academic breadth of architectural science, which consists of the three systems of planning and design, structure, and environment, from the perspective of each specialized field, and to develop a systematic viewpoint.And, the course also attempts to consider the connections between architecture and other fields of specialization from the students' own perspectives.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              You will learn about the academic breadth of architectural studies, which consists of the three fields of planning and design, structure, and the environment.Each lecture introduces the fascinating aspects of architecture through specific architectural works and examples of recent advanced themes, as well as the research activities of the faculty members based on the perspectives of their respective departments and fields of specialization.
